sources.name: osm_pois
sources.sql: SELECT osm_id, name, tags -> 'name:en' AS name_en, tags -> 'name:ar' AS name_ar, amenity, shop, tourism, historic, office, brand, operator, tags -> 'phone' AS phone, tags -> 'contact:phone' AS contact_phone, tags -> 'website' AS website, tags -> 'contact:website' AS contact_website, tags -> 'opening_hours' AS opening_hours, "addr:housenumber" AS housenumber, "addr:housename" AS housename, way FROM planet_osm_point WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND (amenity IS NOT NULL OR shop IS NOT NULL OR tourism IS NOT NULL OR historic IS NOT NULL OR office IS NOT NULL)

sources.name: streets
sources.sql: SELECT osm_id, name, tags -> 'name:en' AS name_en, tags -> 'name:ar' AS name_ar, highway, ref, way FROM planet_osm_line WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND highway IS NOT NULL

sources.name: places
sources.sql: SELECT osm_id, name, tags -> 'name:en' AS name_en, tags -> 'name:ar' AS name_ar, place, population, capital, way FROM planet_osm_point WHERE place IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL

sources.name: admin_boundaries
sources.sql: SELECT osm_id, name, tags -> 'name:en' AS name_en, tags -> 'name:ar' AS name_ar, boundary, admin_level, way FROM planet_osm_polygon WHERE boundary = 'administrative' AND admin_level IN ('2', '4', '6', '8', '10') AND name IS NOT NULL

sources.name: addresses
sources.sql: SELECT osm_id, COALESCE(tags -> 'addr:housename', tags -> 'addr:housenumber') AS name, tags -> 'addr:housenumber' AS housenumber, tags -> 'addr:street' AS street, tags -> 'addr:postcode' AS postalcode, way FROM planet_osm_point WHERE tags ? 'addr:housenumber'
